Vocational XR · nine trades, nine rooms

Trade Skills Simulator

Each room is a working environment with the real order of operations behind it. The simulator scores what you touch and in what order, explains the consequence of every wrong move, and awards stars for a clean run against par time.

Isolation BayElectrical worker — lockout/tagout and live-dead-live verification
Colour StudioHair stylist — colour service, developer ratio and station sanitation
Hot LineCommercial cook — cross-contamination, cook temp, grease flare-up
Draw StationPhlebotomy — two-identifier check and the order of draw
Weld BayWelder — hot work permit, lens shade, bead control, fire watch
Deploy BayPlatform engineer / SRE — environment promotion and agent-scoped, canary-gated rollout
Rough-In BayPlumber / pipefitter — DWV rough-in, backflow prevention, torch brazing and a pressure test
Wash-Down YardLaborer (LIUNA) — contained pressure-wash: nozzle, pressure, standoff, coverage, water recovery
Coatings BayPainter (IUPAT) / hazmat crew — lead-safe airless spray: containment, tip, pressure, pattern, film build

Desktop: W A S D move, drag to look, click to act, hold on timed steps.
Headset: open in the Meta Quest Browser and press Enter VR — point and pull the trigger, left stick glides, right stick snap-turns.

Progress, stars and badges are stored in this browser only — nothing is transmitted. Immersive mode needs a WebXR browser; Ray-Ban Meta display glasses cannot run immersive WebXR, so on those this page is a flat phone view.

Your level, XP and badges carry over to SmartCiti.X, 20 more union-trade simulators (lineworker, tower climber, crane operator and more) built on the same engine — one shared apprentice record across both. See the network map for all four apps in this repository, including Holodeck's prompt-driven procedure generator.
